title: release v0.32.0
desiredOutcome: One release commit carries the bump to 0.32.0, the finalized CHANGELOG section and the regenerated shipped reports; the annotated tag v0.32.0 lands on that commit only after CI is green on it.
summary: v0.32.0 released as one commit + one annotated tag (the first since v0.9.0, per the recorded decision): the P9-P16 refactor arc, the dev-only lint gate, the enforced module structure, and the five bug fixes the first honest CI runs surfaced.

tasks.title: bump + CHANGELOG + regenerated artifacts, tag after green CI

outcome.technical: plugin.json 0.31.0 -> 0.32.0; CHANGELOG [0.32.0] in the house voice (refactor P9-P16, dev lint gate, _deps enforcement, F8/BUG-2..5 fixes); shipped reports regenerated via examples/report.sh with the 0.32.0 stamp, cmp holds. Full battery green locally incl. claude plugin validate; the annotated tag follows the green CI on this commit.
